title: NewsItem
description: A single financial news entry sourced from feed.mix.sina.com.cn (or cached locally).

source.description: Publisher or origin feed identifier (e.g. sina, cls, wallstreetcn).

ts.description: Unix epoch seconds when the news item was published.

key.description: Stable unique key used to address the item via news.read.

summary.description: Short plain-text summary shown on the news card list.

tags.description: Optional categorization tags (e.g. 宏观, A股, 加密, 外汇).
